messages:
AJ: Hey team, customer asking in their SQ: we retain full request/response logs for 90d but they want a contiguous export for a 7-day window including token-level redaction proof. How do we respond given sampling + high-volume prefix caching?
Maria: quick answer: we can produce an audited export for a tenant for a bounded window. sample vs full depends on plan — hosted default is sampled at high QPS to save costs, Dedicated can do full capture. :eyes:
AJ: Customer is on Hosted with enterprise subscription (no Dedicated). They specifically asked for: (1) raw request/response pairs with redaction markers, (2) proof that no KMS keys were exfiltrated and envelope rotation timeline, (3) tamper-proof audit chain.
Maria: ok. for (1) we can replay from prefix/KV cache + request logs; however full request body retention at token granularity is limited on Hosted because of storage. we have a documented "export-with-redaction" flow we can run per-tenant.
Devon: adding technical detail — export pipeline steps: 1) pull request_ids for timeframe, 2) rehydrate tokenized payloads from blobstore (if retained), 3) apply deterministic redaction (PII ruleset v3), 4) sign each record with our audit key.
Maria: include this snippet for the playbook we send customers:
```bash
# generate signed export
redwood-logs export --tenant TENANT_ID \
  --since 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z --until 2026-03-08T23:59:59Z \
  --redact-rules v3 --signer /secrets/audit-key.pem \
  --output tenant-2026-03-01_08.tar.gz
```
AJ: they asked about KMS envelope rotation proof — they want to confirm no plaintext keys ever left HSM and to see rotation events.
Maria: for KMS proof we provide: key metadata timeline (creation, rotation, disable) + CMK policy snapshots + Cloud HSM audit events. we can also produce an export of envelope headers (no wrapped keys, just key IDs + timestamps) and a signed statement.
Devon: technical caveat: Hosted uses our KMS bridge (customer envelope keys are wrapped by our CMK only for Dedicated/private with BYO-KEK). For Hosted enterprise we do envelope encryption with per-tenant envelope keys rotated monthly. We can present HSM audit logs showing Sign/Unwrap events but not the plaintext.
AJ: customer also asked about log sampling: they saw gaps and worried we dropped auth events. what's the short explanation?
Maria: sampling is deterministic per-tenant+hour when QPS exceeds threshold. it keeps one in N requests plus adaptive capture on anomalies (errors, latency spikes). we can run a deterministic re-run across raw shards to show whether a specific request_id was sampled or dropped.
Devon: if they need guaranteed continuity we recommend Dedicated or a temporary elevated-capture window on Hosted (we did this once for a SOC demo). That will capture 100% for the requested window and we can sign the export.
AJ: outstanding asks for the reply: 1) a one-page summary (legal-friendly) of what we can provide, 2) an ops runbook we will execute (steps + artifacts list), 3) a sample signed export (sanitized) and 4) timeline for KMS proof generation.
Maria: I'll draft the one-pager and runbook. Devon can you prepare the sanitized sample export and confirm the time estimate for HSM audit pulls?
Devon: I can produce the sample export tomorrow (sanitized) and HSM audit pull will take 48-72h to get formal logs from our HSM provider and sign them. Need sec-bot to append the audit-key certificate chain.
sec-bot: ack — will attach cert chain and our current audit-key fingerprint to the export.
AJ: perfect. i'll respond to the customer with that scope and timeline. thanks all :thumbsup:
Maria: FYI I'll include the deterministic sampling query we'll run and a short appendix on differences between hosted/dedicated expectations. will ping when draft done.
Devon: creating a ticket for elevated capture in case the customer upgrades — ping me if you want that toggled.
AJ: closing loop — i'll send the initial reply and include an offer for a short call to review the artifacts. thanks! :wave:
